subscriptions.title: Subscriptions
subscriptions.description: Topic filters (+, #) to receive, each with its QoS. $share/<group>/<filter> is a shared subscription: the broker spreads its messages over the clients in the group.

no_local.description: MQTT 5: not the messages this client publishes.

retain_as_published.description: MQTT 5: keep the retain flag as published.

retain_handling.description: MQTT 5: when retained messages are sent: at every subscribe, only for a new subscription, or never.

ack_mode.title: Acknowledge
ack_mode.description: confirmed: a message is acknowledged to the broker once the hub has its event (at least once, end to end). on_emit: once it's sent (faster; events in flight can be lost in a crash). QoS 0 needs no acknowledgement.

tls_ca.title: CA certificate
tls_ca.description: Uploaded PEM file with the CA(s) of the broker's certificate. Default: the bundled Mozilla roots.

tls_cert.title: Client certificate
tls_cert.description: Uploaded PEM file: a client certificate (mTLS), with tls_key.

tls_key.title: Client key
tls_key.description: Uploaded PEM file: the client certificate's private key.

insecure_skip_verify.title: Skip certificate checks
insecure_skip_verify.description: Development only: accept any broker certificate.

client_id.title: Client id
client_id.description: Unique per broker. Default: flwrs-<node id>.

clean_start.title: Clean start
clean_start.description: Start without the broker session: messages queued while the plugin was away are lost. Off (the default): the broker keeps the session and its unacknowledged messages.

session_expiry_s.title: Session expiry (s)
session_expiry_s.description: MQTT 5: how long the broker keeps the session after a disconnect. Default 3600 (none with clean_start).

max_inflight.title: Max in flight
max_inflight.description: QoS 1 / 2 messages the broker may send before they're acknowledged (MQTT 5 Receive Maximum).

max_qos0_buffered.title: QoS 0 buffer
max_qos0_buffered.description: QoS 0 messages kept while the hub isn't taking events; more are dropped (and counted in a WARN).

max_packet_bytes.title: Max packet size
max_packet_bytes.description: Largest packet the broker may send, in bytes.

last_will.title: Last Will
last_will.description: Published by the broker if the connection drops without a clean disconnect.
